ORBITAL DEFENSE SYSTEMS REPORTS Q4 FISCAL 2025 RESULTS

Orbital Defense Systems (NASDAQ: ORBD) today announced financial results for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025. Revenue was $3,312,000 thousand, up 7.6% year over year. GAAP net income was $250,100 thousand, or $0.46 per diluted share. Non-GAAP net income was $268,140 thousand, or $0.50 per diluted share. Non-GAAP measures exclude stock-based compensation of $22,000 thousand; there were no other adjusting items in the quarter. For fiscal 2025, the company now expects revenue of $13,800,000 thousand to $14,100,000 thousand on a GAAP basis.

Condensed income statement (in thousands, unaudited)
  Revenue                       $3,312,000 thousand
  Cost of revenue               $2,651,000 thousand
  Gross profit                  $661,000 thousand
  Operating expenses            $356,000 thousand
  Operating income (loss)       $305,000 thousand
  Income tax expense            $54,900 thousand
  Net income (loss)             $250,100 thousand
  Diluted shares (millions)     540.0

Prior-year quarter: revenue $3,077,000 thousand; operating income $288,000 thousand.
